blocker_detail: The skill's primary build deliverable (Step 4) is generated by running the bundled script scripts/build_recipe.py, which merges a detection recipe JSON, a send template JSON, and the user's IDs into one GTM import container. This office-assistant runtime cannot run code or shell commands of any kind, so the script cannot be executed; the run's added rules also forbid writing my own replacement, stub, or hand-merged substitute for a bundled script, so the import file cannot be produced here. Separately, the skill's overriding non-negotiable is that the job is not done until a fired test conversion is shown to have arrived at the destination; verification requires a live browser on the real page plus access to the Google Ads / GTM account, neither of which this runtime (no browser automation, no accounts, and web fetch disabled for this run) can reach. All build inputs were confirmed present (event-map.json has the gravity-forms entry with event gravity_form_submitted; assets/gtm-recipes/detect/detect-gravity-forms.json and assets/gtm-recipes/send/google-ads.json both exist), so the only thing missing is the ability to execute the producing script and to run a live verification.
